saddlehud.config.title: Saddle HUD
saddlehud.config.showFoodWhileMounted.to: Show your food bar while riding, with your mount's health one row above
saddlehud.config.experienceUntilJump.too: Keep the experience bar while riding and switch to the jump bar only while jumping
saddlehud.config.showMountArmor.tooltip: Show your mount's armor as a row of armor icons above its hearts
saddlehud.config.showMountStats.tooltip: Show your horse's top speed and jump height next to the hotbar while riding. Green is great, yellow is average, red is slow
saddlehud.config.lowHealthWarning.toolti: Make your mount's hearts blink and play a sound when it drops below 30% health
